items.title: Manuel Mello Interview, 1959-08-03
items.q: I played in every hall this side of the river from Mac Main's funeral call on Napoleon Avenue

ctx.x: I'd like to know the names of some of the places where you used to play. Well, I played

in every hall this side of the river from Mac Main's funeral call on Napoleon Avenue, our fellow's hall. I played the Athenaeum, played Stoll's hall, I played the Portuguese hall, I played Tolman's hall, I played back of Beatus, I played at the other hall on Almonster, I think in Oikwa, they had a hall there. The Bowie, I think they called themselves. And I played the Pink's, I played Kambasa's hall, I played the St. Maurice hall, I played the Crescent City Carnival Club on this side of the river. On the other…
Did they have special picnic grounds? Oh, yeah.
